messages:
mara: Noticed a flaky issue in the sampleapp: after hot-reload, first few logs lack request IDs. Also saw redaction strip our hex-ids in some builds. Repro notes: start with --fast-reload, hit /status.

kevin_dev: Reproed locally. Root cause looks like OTEL auto-hook attaching later than reqid middleware registration during dev reload, so logger shim sees no context on first request.

oliqa: For parity, Go init is synchronous so rare. Node examples show async init in README which encourages this pattern. We should change examples.

sam_sre: Two fixes: 1) sampleapp add early lightweight reqid fallback middleware, 2) docs: add a sync-init quickstart and a "dev reload" note.

priya: About redaction: our scrubber pattern treats 32-char hex as secret by default. That collides with Go/Node request ids. Propose whitelist headers (X-Request-Id, Request-Id) and run normalizer before scrubbing.

ci-bot: Created ticket INT-4672 (hot-reload-reqid-loss + redaction-whitelist). Priority: P3.

kevin_dev: I'll update Node quickstart today to show sync init and an early-fallback snippet.

mara: Can we add a tiny metric so we know when fallback is used? e.g., telemetry.counter('reqid.fallback_used')

sam_sre: Yes add counter and alert if >0 per boot. That gives us signal for customers.

oliqa: I'll add unit tests for parity: ensure reqid format preserved after redactor for Node, Go, Python.

priya: I'll modify redactor config: add preserve_headers list and move normalizer earlier. Also update docs about customizing scrub rules.

kevin_dev: Sample log snippet for QA:
```
2026-03-24T11:05:00.001Z INFO http GET /status { msg: 'start' }
2026-03-24T11:05:00.005Z DEBUG telemetry init complete
2026-03-24T11:05:00.006Z INFO http GET /status { request_id: 'c0a8f1e2b3c4d5e6f7890a1b2c3d4e5f', msg: 'after' }
```

mara: Timeline? Can we canary next week?

kevin_dev: PR for sampleapp + tests today, redactor tweak tomorrow, canary early next week.

mara: thanks all. tagging @kevin_dev @priya @oliqa. I'll add links to INT-4672 once PRs land. :thumbsup:
